CDS Hooks recommends ES384 and RS384 for JWT signature verification.
Select which method to use.

inputs.name: jwks_kid
inputs.label: CDS Services JWKS kid
inputs.description:
The key ID of the JWKS private key to use for signing the JWTs when invoking a CDS service endpoint
requiring authentication.
Defaults to the first JWK in the list if no kid is supplied.

inputs.name: crd_discovery_service_ignore_list

inputs.description:
In the case that CDS services advertised on this server support
              use cases outside the scope of the CRD specification, provide a
              comma-separated list of service IDs to opt-out of CRD validation.
              Ignored services will not be stored for use in later tests.  If
              blank, all services are checked and saved.

inputs.name: encryption_method
inputs.label: JWT Signing Algorithm
inputs.description:
CDS Hooks recommends ES384 and RS384 for JWT signature verification.
Select which method to use.

inputs.name: jwks_kid
inputs.label: CDS Services JWKS kid
inputs.description:
The key ID of the JWKS private key to use for signing the JWTs when invoking a CDS service endpoint
requiring authentication.
Defaults to the first JWK in the list if no kid is supplied.

inputs.name: encounter_start_service_ids
inputs.label: Service id for the service that implements the `encounter-start` hook
inputs.description:
If blank, Inferno will attempt to infer the service id to use by finding a service entry in the
              Discovery response for the target hook. If it cannot be inferred, the tests will be skipped.

inputs.name: encounter_start_request_bodies
inputs.label: Request body or bodies for invoking the `encounter-start` hook
inputs.description: To send multiple requests, provide as a JSON list, e.g., [json_body_1, json_body_2].

inputs.name: mock_ehr_bundle
inputs.label: Mock EHR Data
inputs.description:
A FHIR Bundle containing resources that Inferno will make available via the FHIR API hosted
by its simulated CRD client that will initiate the CDS Hooks requests.

inputs.name: manual_continuation
inputs.label: Require acknowledgement of completed hook requests?
inputs.description:
By default, Inferno will continue evaluation of the hook response(s) immediately after completing
              the request(s). To keep Inferno's simulated CRD Client and its FHIR endpoints active longer,
              select the "Continue on user acknowledgement" option and you will be asked to click a link when
              you are ready for Inferno to continue.

inputs.name: encryption_method
inputs.label: JWT Signing Algorithm
inputs.description:
CDS Hooks recommends ES384 and RS384 for JWT signature verification.
Select which method to use.

inputs.name: jwks_kid
inputs.label: CDS Services JWKS kid
inputs.description:
The key ID of the JWKS private key to use for signing the JWTs when invoking a CDS service endpoint
requiring authentication.
Defaults to the first JWK in the list if no kid is supplied.

inputs.name: encounter_discharge_service_ids
inputs.label: Service id for the service that implements the `encounter-discharge` hook
inputs.description:
If blank, Inferno will attempt to infer the service id to use by finding a service entry in the
              Discovery response for the target hook. If it cannot be inferred, the tests will be skipped.

inputs.name: encounter_discharge_request_bodies
inputs.label: Request body or bodies for invoking the `encounter-discharge` hook
inputs.description: To send multiple requests, provide as a JSON list, e.g., [json_body_1, json_body_2].

inputs.name: mock_ehr_bundle
inputs.label: Mock EHR Data
inputs.description:
A FHIR Bundle containing resources that Inferno will make available via the FHIR API hosted
by its simulated CRD client that will initiate the CDS Hooks requests.

inputs.name: manual_continuation
inputs.label: Require acknowledgement of completed hook requests?
inputs.description:
By default, Inferno will continue evaluation of the hook response(s) immediately after completing
              the request(s). To keep Inferno's simulated CRD Client and its FHIR endpoints active longer,
              select the "Continue on user acknowledgement" option and you will be asked to click a link when
              you are ready for Inferno to continue.
